name: Mana Ledger
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr && pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py migrate && (python manage.py load_rules --if-missing || echo Rules can be loaded later from the Rules page)

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional. A Postgres address (for example from neon.tech) so your collection is kept permanently. Leave blank to use a local file.
